name: Kougaï
languagesCustom: The languages it knew in life
biography: Entominid bellator. A mantis-shelled yokai of endless hunger that reforms days after destruction — unless someone feeds it a comfort food it loved in life before it dies. Habitat: Desert.

features.name: Back for Seconds
features.description: If the kougaï is destroyed, it reforms and regains all its Hit Points in 3d10 days unless it was fed a comfort food it loved in life within 24 hours before its death. The new body appears in a location within 1 mile of where it died.

features.name: Endless Hunger
features.description: If damage reduces the kougaï to 0 Hit Points, it is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead. This trait doesn't activate if the kougaï has taken Fire damage since the start of its last turn.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: The kougaï has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Lantern Shell
features.description: Fire burning inside the kougaï's shell destabilizes its connection to its carapace and makes the spaces between the plates glow brightly. When the kougaï takes 5+ Fire damage in a single instance, the next attack roll made against it before the end of its next turn has Advantage.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The kougaï makes one Pincer attack and two Spirit Kama attacks.

features.name: Pincer
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of two pincers. Until the grapple ends, the target is Restrained and the kougaï can't use that pincer to attack other targets.

features.name: Spirit Kama
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Consume Vitality (Recharge 6)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 14 Constitution, one creature the kougaï is grappling. Failure: The target is reduced to 1 Hit Point.

features.name: Hungry Eyes
features.description: The kougaï raises its pincers in an intimidating imitation of eyes. Saving Throw: DC 14 Wisdom, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the kougaï that can see it. Failure: The target is Frightened of the kougaï and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Frightened, the target's Speed is reduced to 0. Success: The target is immune to this effect for 24 hours.
